scope: Maintained exact-identity snapshot joined to the accepted current 79-part BOM. No new live lookup; all catalog timestamps preserved. No supplier upload, order, reservation or native CAD change.
subtotal_basis: Sum of fitted one-board quantities multiplied by each current catalog 1+ unit price, with no discount-tier optimization; not an order quote.
limitations: Unreserved JLC assembly inventory is time-sensitive. Revalidate exact selected MPN, quantity and stock at authorized order release.
Each live UI stayed at quantity 1. One-board per-SKU demands 1-15 were compared with Available Order Qty and minimum 1; no order/cart acceptance was tested.
Catalog stock and PCBA Type are component-level evidence, not manufacturer acceptance of this final board or a one-board assembly MOQ.
Generic Step 1 Pre-order tutorial text appears on these in-stock pages and is not a preorder-only availability status.
Only U3 ICM-42688-P has an explicit current X-ray Required field. Absence on other pages is not a claim that inspection is unnecessary.

J3 current page has no fixture warning. The older active review manufacturing-audit copy says mandatory fixture, but the research audit explicitly corrected that indexed claim. Supplier confirmation remains open.
Existing J3 manufacturer drawing gives -25 to +85 C, differing from catalog -40 C. Exact harness/terminal/mated envelope and cavity1 qualification remain open; do not infer JST mating compatibility.
The exact selected TDK inductor remains Production (NRND), and interchangeability with -N is not guaranteed.

Exact TXC lot/startup/drive qualification, final supplier rotation/pickup preview, connector shell solder process, shared stencil, Standard double-sided carrier/panel acceptance and final native checks remain release gates governed by the separate six-layer manufacturing audit.
A generic Too many requests page interrupted C23186. One ordinary reload after about one minute recovered it; all 34 were then positively observed. No access denial or authentication bypass occurred.
The prior 34-SKU observations retain their original 20:25-20:30 UTC timestamps; Q2 retains its 23:10 UTC observation. This reconciliation is not a fresh stock check.
